message: No detected input validation: The code performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on incoming data; split name validation in _set_files raises ValueError but that is control-flow branching, not defensive data validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local file paths only (os.path.join, open, PIL.Image.open, scipy.io.loadmat); there is no remote fetch and therefore no checksum, signed URL, or authentication mechanism.

No detected label flipping detection: The code performs basic label remapping (e.g., label -= 1, label[label == -1] = 255) but never validates label distributions, compares them to an expected set, or uses any noise-detection tool like Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection routines, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples anywhere in the visible data-preparation code.

No detected model integrity verification: The resume checkpoint is loaded via torch.load (inside Trainer/BaseTrainer) with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision visible anywhere in the code.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, gradient anomaly detection, or activation-pattern analysis anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The code uses a val_loader for evaluation but there is no explicit isolation of a held-out test set from training data, no cryptographic hashing/signing of evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metric sources to guard against manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads data directly from files and passes it to the model without any shape, range, or schema validation on the inference path.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validations are applied to model outputs before they are used or returned.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision segmentation pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
